Examples.Title: Create a channel
Examples.Description: Create a channel in a project, with the default rules. The project's first channel becomes its default. Needs the `channels:write` permission.
Examples.Code:
### Create a channel
# @name management-channels-create
POST {{host}}/projects/{{projectId}}/channels
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "name": "string",
  "key": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "contentType": "profile"
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Channel created successfully
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid input data
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Authorization not provided
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Insufficient access
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not found
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Delete a channel
Examples.Description: Delete a channel. Its key is freed for a new channel. When it was the default, the oldest remaining channel becomes the default. A channel that still moderates a Slack workspace must be disconnected first. Needs the `channels:write` permission.
Examples.Code:
### Delete a channel
# @name management-channels-delete
DELETE {{host}}/channels/{{id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Channel deleted successfully

# 401

# 403

# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not found
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Update a channel
Examples.Description: Update a channel. Fields you leave out keep their value. Needs the `channels:write` permission.
Examples.Code:
### Update a channel
# @name management-channels-update
PUT {{host}}/channels/{{id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "name": "string",
  "key": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "contentType": "profile",
  "flaggingMode": "DRY_RUN",
  "contextEnabled": true,
  "enableImageModeration": true,
  "enableVideoModeration": true,
  "enableAudioModeration": true,
  "enableVoiceModeration": true,
  "includeTranscriptInResponse": true,
  "transcriptionQuality": "SPEED",
  "unicodeSpoofDetectionEnabled": true,
  "frameCaptureInterval": 0,
  "maxFramesPerVideo": 0,
  "spreadFrames": true
}

Examples.Title: Create a webhook
Examples.Description: Create a webhook subscribed to one or more event types. Deliveries use the v2 envelope and are signed with the project signing secret (see the signing secret endpoint).
Examples.Code:
### Create a webhook
# @name webhooks-publicCreate
POST {{host}}/webhooks
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "eventTypes": [
    "QUEUE_ITEM_NEW"
  ]
}

Examples.Title: Get the webhook signing secret
Examples.Description: Get the signing secret used to sign webhook deliveries for this project, creating one if none exists yet. Verify deliveries by comparing the `modapi-signature` header to HMAC-SHA256(raw request body, secret) hex-encoded.
Examples.Code:
using var client = new ModerationAPIClient(apiKey);
var response = await client.Webhooks.WebhooksPublicGetSecretAsync();
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using ModerationAPI;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.
